Text:
# OSTEOMYELITIS

Obtain material for gram-stain and culture before initiating antimicrobials.
Blood and bone cultures are ideal.

Antibiotics should be held if patient does not have adjacent skin/soft tissue infection.
Duration of treatment and route will vary with differences in location of infection, infecting organism, and host comorbidities.

For patients with infections associated with prosthetic materials see [Infections in bone or joint prostheses](pros-joint-bone-infect)

## Recommend Infectious Disease consultation.

Bone culture is essential and diagnostic. If patient is not clinically ill and a
diagnostic procedure is planned, antibiotics can be held until after the
procedure.

Therapy should be modified when culture results and patient response to therapy
are known.

Duration of treatment is 4 to 6 weeks.  Can consider oral conversion sooner.

_______________________________________________________________________________

References:

Sanford: key term: Osteomyelitis
Mandell Chapter: Osteomyelitis
Berbari EF Clin Infect Dis 2015, 61:e26
Calhoun JH Infect Dis Clin North AM 2005, 19:765
Lipsky BA Clin Infect Dis 2012, 54:393
Therapy:
Ceftriaxone 2 gm IV q24h

History of Pseudomonas in wound:
CrCl > 20 mL/min: Piperacillin-tazobactam 3.375 gm IV q8h infuse over 4hrs

CrCl < 20 mL/min or Intermittent Hemodialysis/Peritoneal Dialysis: Piperacillin-tazobactam 3.375 gm IV q12h infuse over 4hrs

CRRT: Piperacillin-tazobactam 3.375 gm IV q8h infuse over 4hrs

Obesity:
BMI > 30 kg/m2: Piperacillin-tazobactam 4.5 gm IV q8h infuse over 4hrs (Change to q12h for CrCl < 20 mL/min or Intermittent Hemodialysis/Peritoneal Dialysis)

BMI >50 kg/m2: Piperacillin-tazobactam 4.5 gm IV q6h infuse over 4hrs (Change to q8h for CrCl < 20 mL/min Intermittent Hemodialysis/Peritoneal Dialysis)

If MRSA history:
<ADD> vancomycin 15 mg/kg IV q12h

## Oral switch recommendations based on culture results

Treatment for MSSA and streptococci:
Cefadroxil 1000 mg PO q12h

Treatment for MRSA:
Doxycycline 100 mg PO q12h
< OR >
Trimethoprim-sulfamethoxazole 1 DS tablet PO q12h
